provenance.note: This visible case assesses evidence mapping; it is separate from the existing single protected held-out runtime scenario and from the student authored Markdown defense.

E61.observation: The API persists and publishes an exception then returns 202; the sequential worker calls the deterministic-local provider and persists terminal state.

E62.observation: Baseline 2 accepted 2481 and completed 106; injected run accepted 2383 and completed 48, in their documented windows.

E63.observation: Worker count model applies one 30% margin to projected arrival times pooled service, then ceilings once. Inputs are hypothetical traffic plus captured local worker service.

E64.observation: A two-worker local pilot rolls back on duplicate side effects or database p95 >200 ms; measure completions, queue age, database p95 and duplicates.

E65.observation: The provider is deterministic-local; the local Compose topology has no production availability, cloud elasticity, provider-quality or production capacity guarantee.

E66.observation: Redis XLEN counts retained entries; accepted-to-terminal durations include queue wait; API and worker marginal p95 values cannot be added to recover end-to-end p95.

decision_claims.D01: The observed downstream worker stage warrants a bounded scaling investigation.
decision_claims.D02: The planning worker count is a modeled estimate, not observed production capacity.
decision_claims.D03: Use a two-worker local pilot with rollback and measurement gates.
decision_claims.D04: Claim the local test proves production model quality and high availability.

review_cases.R01: A reviewer substitutes Redis XLEN for unfinished-job backlog.
review_cases.R02: A reviewer adds API p95 and worker p95 to claim end-to-end p95.
review_cases.R03: A reviewer cites a source-defined 202 response as proof the asynchronous job completed.
review_cases.R04: A reviewer separates hypothetical 10x traffic inputs from measured local service time.

selection_instruction: For each claim/review, select all minimal directly applicable evidence records. D01 needs topology and load observations; D02 needs the model and its fidelity boundary. Use the stated pilot policy for the next measurement.

definitions.supported: Evidence directly establishes the bounded claim.
definitions.insufficient-evidence: Evidence does not establish the claim, even when it warns against assuming it.
